_help: Courtside settings. auto_publish_from: null means Matthew approves every anchor take on courtside-desk.html; a date (YYYY-MM-DD) lets drafts from that night on publish without review (held ones stay down). comments.provider: blank for no reader comments, or giscus (repo, repo_id, category, category_id from giscus.app) or cusdis (app_id, host). enabled: false turns Courtside off everywhere.
